note: DT.1i: model drift in contract_fields. An Angular portal reads GET /api/plans/:id as its Plan interface (id, name, priceCents, trialDays); the gin handler writes planBody (id, name, priceCents), and the swagger.json op documenting the route declares the same three as its 200 response. So contract_fields reports two drift rows for one exchange: http_model `GET /api/plans/:id response` (the client against the server's model, trialDays json_field_missing, breaking) and client_contract `GET /api/plans/{id} response` (the client against the documenting op's SCHEMA_FIELDS, trialDays contract_field_undeclared, breaking). The swaggo `@Router` comment on GetPlan documents the route too but carries no SCHEMA_FIELDS, so it gives no client_contract row. engine/tests/model_drift.rs pins the rows.

expect_edges.note: the swagger.json op documents the route; its SCHEMA_FIELDS are what client_contract compares the client with

expect_cells.note: DT.1d: the call's response type argument, the client side of both drift rows
